newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Kirch group rejects controversial loan.
newsitem.headline: German Kirch group rejects controversial loan.

text.p: German media group Kirch said on Friday it would not take up a controversial credit line with had been extended to it by banks including a loan agency controlled by the state of Bavaria.

In a statement, Kirch said it had entered negotiations over a loan package with the LfA agency (Landesanstalt fuer Aufbaufinanzierung) but had decided not to take up the loan because of the publicity that has surrounded the incident.

"In the light of the unobjective public discussion about a normal, confidential business transaction, the Kirch Group will not take up the loan supported by the management board and administrative council of the LfA," the company said.
